text: Field instruments and control equipment shall be rated for the ambient range of DP-CASE-0007 to DP-CASE-0009, the marine C5 atmosphere (DP-CASE-0003) with the salt and chloride loads of DP-OWNR-0005 and DP-OWNR-0007, and the seismic design of DP-CASE-0002. Seawater-wetted parts shall be designed for the chloride content and temperature of DP-OWNR-0014 and DP-CASE-0013 and the intermittent chlorination of DEC-EPCE-0015.
